c.description:
Prestigious Vancouver West side Dunbar — Stylish newly renovated and fully furnished (Vacation & Extended Stay)

Space: 3 bedrooms • 1.5 washrooms • full kitchen with island • living room dining room and family room • in‑suite laundry • linens, basic kitchenware included.
Price: $280/day + one‑time cleaning fee $180. One month up to six month.

• 10 min to Kitsilano Beach and downtown
• Short walk to Tim Hortons, Dairy Queen, coffee shops, sushi and restaurants
Ideal for: short vacations or extended work assignments.
